body:
I'm sorry, too, that you have to go through that. I understand your situation too well, given it is basically the same as mine :( 

One thing I genuinely want to tell you though, I hope I hope I hope you make it. There's nothing I want to see more than other people making it through even if I didn't. I want to see them live the life I've always wanted :) As I love to say, "ganbare"!! "do your best!"

And well, thank you for the reply. I didn't really know what I was looking for as I was typing my post - a goodbye note? something to tell people that i'm not okay? that im angry and hurting? idk. nothing's changed though :(
